evidence.title: Auditing Cross-Lingual Fairness in Language Model Watermarking

summary: Researchers have conducted a comprehensive audit of watermarking methods used to embed traceable signals in large language models, focusing on how these techniques perform across different languages. The analysis reveals notable disparities in detection accuracy and bias, prompting calls for more equitable watermarking standards worldwide.
title: Study Audits Cross-Lingual Fairness of Language Model Watermarking Techniques
